name: NWEBHD
recent: NWE Resources Group Berhad 于2026年10月21日在ACE市场上市，首次公开募股发行1.43亿股新股，发行价每股RM0.20。上市后，多名董事及集团财务经理在公开市场或通过粉表认购方式增持股份，公司最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为1058.5万令吉，净利280万令吉。
notable: 公司于2026年10月21日在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市，首次公开募股发行1.43亿股新股，发行价每股RM0.20。
多名董事及集团财务经理在上市后认购公司股份，其中独立非执行主席认购100万股。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，公司营收为1058.5万令吉，净利为280万令吉，净利率为26.5%。

recent_en: NWE Resources Group Berhad listed on the ACE Market on 21 October 2026, issuing 143.1 million new shares at RM0.20 per share. After listing, several directors and the group finance manager acquired shares via the open market or pink form allocation, while one senior officer disposed of 200,000 shares on 21 October. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM10.585 million and net profit was RM2.8 million.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 21 October 2026, with an IPO of 143.1 million new shares at RM0.20 per share.
Several directors and the group finance manager subscribed for shares following the listing, including the Independent Non-Executive Chairman who subscribed 1,000,000 shares.
The group finance manager disposed of 200,000 ordinary shares on 21 October 2026.
risks_en: The group finance manager disposed of 200,000 shares, representing approximately 0.037% of issued shares, shortly after the listing.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM10.585 million, net profit was RM2.8 million, and net margin was 26.5%.
